segments.LAM.1.1-2: Jerusalem is lonely and has no comforter
segments.LAM.1.3-3: Judah is in exile and finds no rest
segments.LAM.1.4-5: Zion mourns, and her children are taken captive
segments.LAM.1.6-6: The splendor of Zion is gone and her princes are weak
segments.LAM.1.7-7: Jerusalem remembers her treasures while enemies laugh
segments.LAM.1.8-9: Jerusalem sinned and is now despised
segments.LAM.1.10-10: Enemies take treasures and enter the sanctuary
segments.LAM.1.11-12: Jerusalem asks the LORD to see her great sorrow
segments.LAM.1.13-14: The LORD’s hand has broken Jerusalem’s strength
segments.LAM.1.15-15: The Lord has crushed Judah’s warriors like grapes
segments.LAM.1.16-17: Jerusalem weeps because no one comforts her
segments.LAM.1.18-19: Jerusalem admits her rebellion and asks all to look
segments.LAM.1.20-20: Jerusalem asks the LORD to see her distress
segments.LAM.1.21-22: Jerusalem asks the LORD to punish her enemies
segments.LAM.2.1-2: The Lord in anger destroys Jerusalem’s dwellings
segments.LAM.2.3-4: The Lord acts like an enemy against Israel
segments.LAM.2.7-7: The Lord rejects his altar and sanctuary
segments.LAM.2.8-9: The LORD destroys Zion’s walls and gates
segments.LAM.2.10-10: Elders and young women of Jerusalem mourn
segments.LAM.2.11-12: The writer weeps for the children fainting from hunger
segments.LAM.2.13-14: Jerusalem’s wound is deep, and false prophets deceived her
segments.LAM.2.17-17: The LORD did what he planned against Jerusalem
segments.LAM.2.18-19: Jerusalem is told to cry to the Lord day and night
segments.LAM.2.20-20: Jerusalem asks the LORD to see her terrible suffering
segments.LAM.2.21-22: Young and old die on the day of the LORD’s anger
segments.LAM.3.1-4: God’s anger has brought great suffering to the writer
segments.LAM.3.5-8: God has shut the writer in darkness and ignores his prayer
segments.LAM.3.9-11: God blocks the writer’s path like a bear or lion
segments.LAM.3.12-15: God makes the writer a target and a laughingstock
segments.LAM.3.16-18: The writer feels his strength and hope have perished
segments.LAM.3.19-21: The writer remembers his suffering, yet has hope
segments.LAM.3.22-24: The LORD’s mercies are new every morning
segments.LAM.3.25-29: It is good to wait quietly for the LORD
segments.LAM.3.30-33: The Lord will not reject his people forever
segments.LAM.3.34-36: The Lord does not approve of injustice
segments.LAM.3.37-39: Everything comes from God, so people should not complain
segments.LAM.3.40-43: The people turn back to the LORD and confess sin
segments.LAM.3.44-47: God blocks prayers, and enemies bring ruin to the people
segments.LAM.3.48-50: The prophet weeps for the destruction of his people
segments.LAM.3.51-54: Enemies hunt the prophet and throw him into a pit
segments.LAM.3.55-57: The prophet calls to the LORD, who comes near
segments.LAM.3.58-61: The prophet asks the LORD to defend him against enemies
segments.LAM.3.62-63: Enemies slander and mock the prophet all day
segments.LAM.3.64-66: The prophet asks the LORD to punish his enemies
segments.LAM.4.1-2: Zion’s people, once precious, are now like clay jars
segments.LAM.4.3-3: Mothers in Zion are more cruel than jackals
segments.LAM.4.4-5: Children go hungry and the once rich are poor
segments.LAM.4.6-6: Zion is punished more than Sodom was
segments.LAM.4.7-8: Once-healthy leaders now look dark and shriveled
segments.LAM.4.9-10: Hunger is so bad that mothers cook children
segments.LAM.4.11-11: The LORD pours out his anger and burns Zion
segments.LAM.4.12-13: Jerusalem falls for the sins of prophets and priests
segments.LAM.4.14-15: Prophets and priests wander blind and are driven away
segments.LAM.4.16-16: The LORD scatters the people, and priests get no honor
segments.LAM.4.19-20: Enemies chase the people and capture the king
segments.LAM.4.21-22: Edom will be punished, but Zion’s punishment is complete
segments.LAM.5.1-4: The people ask the LORD to remember what happened
segments.LAM.5.5-7: The people are weary and suffer for fathers’ sins
segments.LAM.5.8-10: Slaves rule the people, and food is hard to find
segments.LAM.5.11-12: Women are abused and leaders are shamed in Judah
segments.LAM.5.15-16: Joy turns to mourning, and the people admit sin
segments.LAM.5.17-18: The people grow faint over the ruined Mount Zion
segments.LAM.5.19-22: The people ask the LORD to restore the nation
